I'm not sure which of the three of us came up with funfairs...We [realized] a love affair was pretty much like going round and round and round on a carousel. This clip is a gem. In January of 1967, the band was being filmed for a documentary at the very session they recorded "Carousel" at Abbey Road. Next door, in the now-famous Studio Two, the Beatles were putting finishing touches on "Penny Lane." What you hear is the actual recording being made. Note that the digital tech of today didn't exist, and that's largely for the good., It means there's no BS like Autotune, no need to go in and lay down parts over the space of a month or more the way many records are done now. Nope. They did it live then fixed the parts on the spot (or at a subsequent session) with overdubs.
